test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. Cumolative.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is "**Cumolative**."
 
• The correct spelling is "**Cumulative**," which means increasing or increased in quantity, degree, or force by successive additions. 
 
 
• **Example:** The cumulative effect of using energy-saving light bulbs is significant over time.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Cumolative**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Click** - This word refers to a short, sharp sound as of a switch being operated or of two hard objects coming quickly into contact. 

 
 
• **Example**: The door closed with a soft click.
 
 
 
• **Caricature** - A caricature is a picture, description, or imitation of a person in which certain striking characteristics are exaggerated in order to create a comic or grotesque effect.
 
 
• **Example**: The political cartoonist drew a caricature of the president with exaggerated features.
 
 
 
• **Cumbersome** - Something that is cumbersome is large or heavy and therefore difficult to carry or use; unwieldy.
 
 
• **Example**: The cumbersome package took up most of the trunk space in the car.
